description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of training step for six model configurations trained on a 20M dataset, with separate lines for ChemBART Small 20M (red), ChemBART Medium 20M (blue), ChemBERTa Small 20M (green), ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange), ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple), and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown). The x-axis is labeled “Step,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to about 440k, with labeled ticks at approximately 0k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 420k, 430k, and 440k (a visible axis break separates the early region up to ~80k from the late region around ~420k–440k). The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges roughly from 0.0 up to about 0.85, with visible tick labels including 0.2, 0.4, 0.75, and 0.85. All six series are drawn as solid lines without markers and show a steep initial decrease from near ~0.8–0.85 at the start toward values around ~0.3–0.4 within the early steps, followed by a flatter region and then a gradual upward drift as steps increase; by the far right of the plot (around 440k steps), the lines cluster around the mid-to-upper 0.4 range, with the green line ending highest (around ~0.50) and the brown/purple lines ending slightly lower (around ~0.46–0.48), while the red/blue/orange lines end in between (around ~0.47–0.49).
